sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.  The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No20 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Para, District Lucknow.
3. This is the second bail application.
The first bail application was rejected by this Court vide order dated 23.02.202.
4. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that on account of non-fulfillment of the demand of dowry, the deceased was done to death.
The postmortem report on record indicates the presence four injury which was the cause of death.

5. While arguing the second bail application, the Counsel for the applicant and the Counsel for the informant states that all the facts witnesses have been examined and the summons have been issued under Section 319 for summoning other persons.
It is also agreed that the applicant is in custody since 09.01.2022 and has no criminal antecedents.

6. The Counsel for the informant vehemently opposed the bail prayer by arguing that even as per the statement and the observations made in an order passed in favour of the co-accused, it was observed that in the state of intoxication, the applicant has committed the offence in question and had cause the head injury, which was the cause of death.
7.
Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

8. Considering the fact as noted above; the fact witnesses have been examined and in terms of the statement, prima facie, the offence was allegedly committed in the state of intoxication; the applicant has suffered pretrial detention of more than three and a half years having no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 09.01.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

9. Let the applicant Vimal Singh Yadav be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
